notes.title: Update: v1.2.3 Patch 2
notes.content:
-If Steam is not running when the game boots, the game now attempts to start Steam without shutting down. This allows you to play the game without Steam, but you won't have access to the leaderboards if you do so.
-Resolved an issue where players will only receive boost items even with more than one player.
-Resolved an issue where players are counted twice when calculating placements.

notes.title: Update: v1.2.3
notes.content:
-Added an option to select a custom server region. You can find this option in the settings menu. Note that the default (worldwide) server is the US East server. Players on different servers cannot connect to each other. If you're playing in a private room with friends far away from the US East region, you can select a server closest to you and make sure everyone else selects the same server.
-Added an option to directly visit the Steam Leaderboard page for the game. You can find it in the leaderboards section of the lobby menu.
-Slightly nerfed player 2 (red)'s speed: 9 --> 8.85 Units/Frame.
